amendment.reason: The v1 trainingamount allocation contained only five minorityclass groups and failed the unchanged minimumten gate before any model was fitted. Forty-thousand moved into training; twenty-thousand reserved. This revision is explicitly coverage-informed development.

specification.districts: All 29 official districts, aligned by declared order; identifiers and labels checked.
specification.target: delta fixed-template nonreject support from known official zero-transfer baseline

split.unit: Exact transfer/vote-table group, including election year.
split.stratification: 2022 exact threshold label only; deterministic hash order, 70/15/remainder. Zero group train anchor.
split.label_use: Test labels define strata, never features, model fit, normalization or rank/seed selection.

specification.selection: Minimum validation RMSE, tie by rank string then seed; no test-driven tuning, no refit.
specification.loss_weighting: Every observed tensor coordinate has equal weight; zero constraints are known anchors.
specification.threshold: Raw continuous baseline + predicted delta >= 175; no rounding or clipping.
specification.unseen_amount_prediction: Prespecified linear interpolation of fitted predictions between enclosing trained amount levels. No learned cold-start factor.
specification.direction_cold_start: Unsupported by categorical CP/Tucker; no new-direction extrapolation claimed.
specification.external_scope: 2026 same declared coordinate levels and known official baseline; retrospective challenge. 2026 and earlier grid outcomes were previously observed in development; not a blind prospective forecast.
specification.promotion: No replacement of exact Rust; superiority and latency value require separate evidence.
specification.failure_policy: Capacity errors, ties, domain exits and unsupported outcomes are masked, never zero-filled. No resplit or design expansion after labels/model results.
